figures.llm_description: FIG. 1. Crystal structure. Middle: Illustration of the trigonal prismatic coordination sphere of the chalcogen atoms (yellow, sulfur; light green, selenium) around the niobium (dark green). Left: Side and top view of the 4H-NbSe2, with four layers per unit cell. Right: Top and side view of the 2H-NbS2, with two layers per unit cell [18].
